## Install

This dotfiles setup manages `ntn` through mise (`"npm:ntn" = "latest"`). If `ntn` is missing, run `mise install npm:ntn`. Do not run the upstream installer (`curl -fsSL https://ntn.dev | bash`) without a separate explicit request.

local_text_replacements.old: Prefer `ntn pages create` / `ntn pages update` for Markdown page content.
local_text_replacements.new: Prefer `ntn pages create` / `ntn pages edit` for Markdown page content. `ntn pages edit` replaces the whole page. For a partial edit, send `update_content` with `old_str`/`new_str` pairs through `ntn api v1/pages/<page-id>/markdown -X PATCH` (check the body shape with `--spec -X PATCH`). Unless the user explicitly asked for that deletion, do not pass `--allow-deleting-content` or `allow_deleting_content: true` (they allow deleting child pages and databases), and do not add `--yes` to `ntn pages trash` or other commands (it skips confirmation).

  If it is set, prefer using it instead of telling the user to run `ntn login`.
